# Private CoverJPEG PSP decode library

Pinned upstream: libjpeg-turbo **3.1.3**, ABI **62**, scalar C, GCC 15.2.0 PSP cross compiler. Full upstream source and licenses remain unmodified in `libjpeg-turbo-3.1.3/`. The private build does not replace the installed PSPSDK library.

Source URL: https://codeload.github.com/libjpeg-turbo/libjpeg-turbo/tar.gz/refs/tags/3.1.3

Downloaded tar.gz SHA256: `3a13a5ba767dc8264bc40b185e41368a80d5d5f945944d1dbaa4b2fb0099f4e5`.

## Integration handoff

Replace the cover decoder's `-ljpeg` with the full path to:

```
third_party/coverjpeg_psp/build-psp/libcoverjpeg8.a
```

The archive goes **after referencing objects** in the static link. No additional library is needed beyond the application's existing C runtime. Do not additionally link the installed `-ljpeg`, since that could silently reintroduce excluded modules.

Use `-Ithird_party/coverjpeg_psp/include` for the matching fixed config. The existing PSPSDK public headers are also layout-compatible: the upstream and SDK `jpeglib.h` are byte-identical (SHA256 `dc3e8220f34b7e9f9e48620f5cb8dc070834feb3214bb12bbad78478ebb29e60`). No root Makefile, PRX build, API/UI/main, or `src/coverjpeg.c` change is part of this delivery.

This is a private decoding subset for the reviewed cover wrapper, not a full replacement for applications requiring JPEG encoding, precision-specific 12/16-bit entry points, or lossless/arithmetic coding.

## Retained and excluded code

Retained: genuine upstream 8-bit baseline/progressive Huffman decoding; grayscale, RGB/YCbCr, CMYK/YCCK conversion; accurate integer IDCT; native 1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8 scaling; progressive buffering and block smoothing; marker parsing; memory-source and normal memory-manager bootstrap. The accurate integer source's other official scaling kernels remain present rather than rewriting the IDCT implementation.

Excluded at source selection/capability level: every encoder module, TurboJPEG API, SIMD, arithmetic coding, lossless decoding, 12/16-bit wrappers, color quantization, floating/fast integer IDCT. No fake symbols, typed shims, or stubs are used.

Upstream `CMakeLists.txt` unconditionally includes 8/12/16-bit wrapper sources and has no `WITH_12BIT` switch. `prepare.py` therefore generates an auditable private source overlay and `decode-only.patch` from the complete original tree. It uses official capability switches in `jmorecfg.h`, rejects non-8-bit precision with `JERR_BAD_PRECISION` in `jdinput.c` and again in master initialization, and removes 12-bit dispatch branches from `jdmaster.c`. All compiled 8-bit modules are upstream implementations. Public records are never reconstructed or copied from an older version.

`config/jconfig.h` is a preserved ABI62/3.1.3 SDK configuration with arithmetic features disabled. Internal config uses `VERSION "3.1.3"`, compiler `__SIZEOF_SIZE_T__`, and scalar compilation. `include/jconfigint.h` is generated by the preparation script. Compiler flags are `-Os -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -G0` for PSP; host uses the same source/capabilities and `-fPIC` instead of `-G0`. Archive metadata uses explicit `ar rcsD`.

## Reproduce on this workstation

No global installation or target execution is needed. Existing MSYS2 bash, Python, GCC/ar and PSP tools are used. Run from the workspace root in PowerShell:

```powershell
& D:/msys64/usr/bin/bash.exe tools/hwdecode/build_coverjpeg_psp.sh psp
& D:/msys64/usr/bin/bash.exe tools/hwdecode/build_coverjpeg_psp.sh host
& C:/Users/Administrator/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/dsh-primary-runtime/dependencies/python/python.exe third_party/coverjpeg_psp/tests/test_slim.py
& D:/msys64/ucrt64/bin/python.exe third_party/coverjpeg_psp/tests/check_abi.py
```

The host fixture runner reuses the existing wrapper test definitions without modifying them, loads its own private DLL from `.tmp/coverjpeg-slim`, and adds native scaling/subsampling combinations, genuine RGB-encoded images, and non-8-bit rejection. Pillow is supplied by the bundled Python. It also builds the PSP probe below and checks that it has no undefined symbols.

Equivalent PSP probes (compile/link only):

```powershell
& E:/pspdev/bin/psp-gcc.exe -Os -G0 -Isrc -Ithird_party/coverjpeg_psp/include src/coverjpeg.c third_party/coverjpeg_psp/tests/link_main.c third_party/coverjpeg_psp/build-psp/libcoverjpeg8.a '-Wl,-Map,.tmp/coverjpeg-slim/slim.map' -o .tmp/coverjpeg-slim/slim.elf
& E:/pspdev/bin/psp-gcc.exe -Os -G0 -Isrc src/coverjpeg.c third_party/coverjpeg_psp/tests/link_main.c E:/pspdev/psp/lib/libjpeg.a '-Wl,-Map,.tmp/coverjpeg-slim/original.map' -o .tmp/coverjpeg-slim/original.elf
& E:/pspdev/bin/psp-size.exe .tmp/coverjpeg-slim/slim.elf .tmp/coverjpeg-slim/original.elf
& E:/pspdev/bin/psp-nm.exe -u .tmp/coverjpeg-slim/slim.elf
```

## Verified results

Identical wrapper/main and linker settings, without section garbage collection:

| Probe | text | data | bss |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Original PSP SDK JPEG | 413688 | 2072 | 173176 |
| Private 8-bit JPEG | 235872 | 1892 | 173176 |
| Saved permanent text+data | **177996 bytes (173.82 KiB)** | | |

The entire probe includes newlib and output/test-main; its full text is not attributed to JPEG. Only the same-probe difference is used for the saving. Full archive section totals are 161900 bytes text for the private subset versus 545819 text + 336 data for the original; these aggregate archive totals are not the application's permanent contribution.

ABI: 13 public records, 253 sizeof/member-offset constants match byte-for-byte between installed SDK headers, private public headers, and actual private compilation headers using the PSP compiler. The ABI report is in `evidence/abi-results.json`.

Host: 12 tests passed, including baseline/progressive RGB/gray/CMYK pixel comparison against Pillow (maximum absolute channel error <=2), 90 native scaling/color/subsampling combinations, genuine RGB-encoded baseline/progressive images, malformed input, truncated scans, allocation failure, 4MiB limit, zero leaked tracked allocation and guarded transactional outputs.

PSP: both probes link successfully; `psp-nm -u slim.elf` produces no output. Maps are under `.tmp/coverjpeg-slim/`. Actual application permanent delta and real 6MiB DDR contiguous allocation must be measured by the integrating owner. No PSP deployment or execution was performed here.
